Name: More Maru Events Revived
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Permissions for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4627]More Maru Events ABANDONED[/url] were open, so I've decided to revive it for 1.6!

This mod adds a few new heart events for Maru:

[list]
[*]A Three Heart Event expanding on her friendship with Penny (Walk into town on a Sunny Day, between 14:00 - 17:00)[/*]
[*]A Five Heart Event expanding on her relationship with her mother, Robin (Walk into the Carpenters Shop on a Rainy Day)[/*]
[*]A Seven Heart Event exploring her motivations and goals (Walk to the Mountains from 20:00 - 23:50. Must have seen Maru's Stargazing event)[/*]
[*]A Nine Heart Event where you can celebrate her birthday with her. (On Maru's Birthday, walk into Town if the weather is Sunny)[/*]
[*]And a secondary event that follows on from her main Ten Heart Event. (After seeing her Ten Heart Event, walk to the Mountains from 21:00 - 23:50)[/*]
[/list]
I may or may not expand on these events in the future (Writing dialogue is HARD lol)

Enjoy!
